title: a shorthand constructor and a full one of the same types are the same signature
purpose: A constructor's identity is its parameter types and variadic shape; a shorthand constructor's types are those of the fields it names, in order.

failure.justification: A declaration-level rule checked after parsing; an implementation may also detect it at registration/runtime. The program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for #1005: one overload identity for actions and constructors
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.3 (#1005): constructors follow the overload identity of actions; names and the shorthand form do not distinguish them.
